title: runnerdb runner
description: One runner type (machine shape) of a provider. Stored at providers/<provider-id>/runners/<id>.json; id must equal the file name.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the provider.

labels.description: Exact `runs-on` labels. A `*` matches any run of non-empty characters (e.g. `macos-*-large`).

os_version.description: Optional OS image hint, e.g. ubuntu-24.04.

vcpu.description: vCPU count; null if not verified.

price_usd_per_minute.description: List price in USD per runtime minute, before scheduling discounts.

public_repo_free.description: True if jobs from public repositories are not billed on this runner.

scheduling_discounts.description: Price factors for optional scheduling modes, e.g. {"flex": 0.6} = 60% of list price.

verified_as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD when the price was last checked against source_url.
